services.title: From one hand to a full bridal night
services.body: Guide prices — final quote depends on design detail, guest numbers and travel. Message on WhatsApp with your date and I'll confirm.

items.title: Bridal Mehndi
items.body: Full hands and feet, intricate Indian, Arabic or fusion work. Includes free design consultation, aftercare kit and touch-ups for the bride.

items.title: Mehndi Party & Guests
items.body: Hourly artist hire for your mehndi night, sangeet or family function. Roughly 6–8 guest designs an hour.

items.title: Eid, Karva Chauth & Festivals
items.body: Seasonal slots at home or pop-up. Book early — Eid and Karva Chauth weeks fill first.

items.title: Baby Showers & Birthdays
items.body: Bump henna, kids' quick motifs and glitter finishes. Gentle, skin-safe paste and fast designs for little hands.

items.title: Events, Fairs & Brands
items.body: University melas, school fairs, corporate Diwali and market stalls. Table, signage and setup included.

items.title: Henna Workshops
items.body: Two-hour beginner classes for hen parties, youth groups and community centres. Cones and practice sheets provided.

items.body: Hathphool and zanjeer chains drawn to echo your actual bridal set — send a photo and I'll match it.

coverage.title: Staffordshire based, happy to travel
coverage.body: Home and venue visits across the Midlands, with travel further afield by arrangement. A small mileage fee may apply for longer journeys, and overnight bookings are welcome for weddings further away.

booking.title: How booking works
steps: Message on WhatsApp with your date, town and occasion.
Share inspiration pictures — I'll quote and hold the slot 48 hours.
£25 deposit confirms the date. Balance on the day, cash or transfer.

safety.title: Only natural henna. Nothing else.
safety.body: Every cone is mixed by hand from body-art quality henna powder sourced from India, with lemon, sugar and essential oils. Fresh paste made for each booking — never shop-bought instant cones.

points.body: pure Lawsonia inermis henna powder, lemon juice, sugar, lavender and cajeput essential oils.
Black henna is illegal on skin in the UK and can cause burns and permanent scarring. It is never used here.
If you have sensitive skin, eczema or a known allergy, ask for a free patch test at least 48 hours before your booking.
Fresh cones per client, sanitised tools, gloves on request, and full aftercare instructions with every booking.

safety.warnBody: Worth knowing wherever you get your mehndi done.

warnings.title: It goes black in under an hour
warnings.body: Natural henna is orange at first and darkens over 48 hours. Instant black means chemicals.

warnings.title: The paste smells chemical
warnings.body: Real henna smells earthy and of essential oils, never of hair dye or ammonia.

warnings.title: It burns or stings
warnings.body: Henna should feel cool. Any stinging — wash it off immediately and seek advice.

items.quote: She stayed until every guest was done and my stain came out almost black.
Calm, quick and so precise. My bridal hands took three hours and flew by.
Booked her for our Eid party at two days' notice — twenty pairs of hands, no fuss.

items.q: When should I have my bridal henna done?
items.a: Two days before the wedding gives the darkest stain. The colour keeps deepening for 48 hours after the paste comes off.
Never. Black henna contains PPD, is illegal on skin in the UK and can burn or scar. I use handmade natural henna only, mixed from body-art quality powder sourced in India.

items.q: How long does a bridal design take?
items.a: Two to five hours depending on coverage. Full hands and feet with dense detail sit at the upper end.

items.q: How do I get the darkest stain?
items.a: Keep the paste on 6–8 hours, scrape it off rather than washing, and avoid water for 12 hours. An aftercare card comes with every bridal booking.

items.q: Do you travel to my venue?
items.a: Yes — home and venue visits across the Midlands, the North West and London. Any travel cost is quoted upfront with your booking.

cta.title: Let's plan your mehndi
cta.body: Tell me your date and town — I'll come back with availability and a price the same day.
